title_cyr: Земај ми го мили тате она девојче
title_latin: Zemaj mi go mili tate ona devojče
title_en: Take for me, dear father, that girl
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Миразличе' is my reading (a girl who brings a dowry); 'их' is an interjection. 'Тук'' is dialectal and my reading.

lines.cyr: - Земај ми го, мили тате, она девојче,
lines.lat: - Zemaj mi go, mili tate, ona devojče,
lines.en: - Take her for me, dear father, that girl,

lines.cyr: - Јас ти нејќам, мили синко, она девојче,
lines.lat: - Jas ti nejḱam, mili sinko, ona devojče,
lines.en: - I don't want her for you, dear son, that girl,

lines.cyr: Јас ќе ти земам, синко, битолчанче,
lines.lat: Jas ḱe ti zemam, sinko, bitolčanče,
lines.en: I will take for you, son, a girl from Bitola,
a girl from Bitola, oh girl.
A girl from Bitola, son, a fair girl,
a fair girl, with a dowry.

lines.cyr: - Јас си неќам, мили тате, битолчанче,
lines.lat: - Jas si neḱam, mili tate, bitolčanče,
lines.en: - I don't want her, dear father, the Bitola girl,
the Bitola girl with a dowry,
I want only my first sweetheart.
